Build a 4-digit BCD (binary-coded decimal) counter. Each decimal digit is encoded using 4 bits: q[3:0] is the ones digit, q[7:4] is the tens digit, etc. For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented. Include a synchronous active-high reset.

Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row. Protocol seed 20261122.
For diagnosis, return JSON {models:{id: Python source string}}. For every assigned item, implement its exact state semantics independently with the same interface. Each string must define reference(vectors) returning every width-valid output each cycle. Follow v3 Python restrictions with no imports, no I/O, and no executable top-level code.
